PRE_IMPLEMENTATION_REUSE_GATE.capabilityScope: Native storage, sell, buy and map-switch preflight under rAthena authority with preserved selected farm map and parent intent

matureReferenceMatrix.currentGiCapability: One-item Native supply triggers and individual storage, sell and buy primitives exist; the current map-switch path stops AUTO_FARM before any supply preflight.
matureReferenceMatrix.openKoreCapability: AI.pm checks storage, sell and buy in order using weight and inventory-slot thresholds; items_control has item-level keep, storage and sell policy with all 0 1 0 fallback.
matureReferenceMatrix.rAthenaCapability: Authoritative character inventory, equipment, item sellability, storage capacity, NPC transactions, weight and Zeny are evaluated in the existing map server.
matureReferenceMatrix.otherMatureReference: NOT_APPLICABLE: no second gameplay runtime is authorized.
matureReferenceMatrix.matureExceptionBehavior: Equipped and unsellable items are excluded from sell; sell amount is capped at quantity above keep; missing NPC service, full storage and insufficient Zeny do not count as success.
matureReferenceMatrix.matureRecoveryBehavior: Supply and map-switch intent remain resumable with bounded retry on service failure; no uncontrolled sell or repeated no-progress loop is accepted.
matureReferenceMatrix.matureConfigSemantics: Historical config thresholds are character-specific evidence: itemsMaxWeight 89, itemsMaxWeight_sellOrStore 68 and itemsMaxNum_sellOrStore 99. Per-item items_control rules and default storage are retained without hard-coding one player's values for everyone.
matureReferenceMatrix.matureUiSemantics: The selected farm map remains visible and pending while service is required; a setting control is enabled only after its Native command contract is executable.
matureReferenceMatrix.directReuse: Existing Native execute_service storage, shop sell and buy primitives, rAthena character state, Web world-map controller, command transport and saved-town return policy.
matureReferenceMatrix.adapt: Port OpenKore trigger order and items_control policy into one Native-owned service flow; expose a typed preflight to Web before stop, fee, cooldown or teleport; resume the original selected-map intent after service.
matureReferenceMatrix.projectPolicy: The 2026-09-24 user decision in docs/project-control/canonical-m1-world-travel-supply-ui-v1.md supersedes combat-consumables-only supply and includes weight, slots, storage, sell and pre-map-switch service.
matureReferenceMatrix.improvements: Use rAthena transaction results and explicit bounded blocking so failures retain the parent intent and cannot report a false map-switch success.
